executive_summary: Worker /signal rows (session_coordination, signal lane) can look dispositioned while remaining structurally open: 153 live rows carry a hand-written payload.disposition yet acknowledged_at is still NULL -- the only field fleet-dashboard.cjs's inbox actually checks -- and a validated critical escalation (signal 26318f2b) sat undispositioned for ~4.4h before a one-off manual batch closed it. This SD extends the existing thin ack mechanism (coordinator-ack-signal.cjs + receipt-ledger.cjs) with a real 5-value disposition vocabulary and single canonical writer (FR-1), surfaces undispositioned age at the coordinator tick (FR-2), backfills the current 262 open rows without corrupting the answered-rate ledger's measurement integrity (FR-3), and gives lone (non-promoted) dispositioned signals a path into the existing SIGNAL_RESOLVED notify-back loop, which today only fires for promotion-derived signals (FR-4). Two LEAD-phase VALIDATION findings are load-bearing constraints here, not afterthoughts: a naive backfill would flatten 10 distinct hand-stamped dispositions into 262 fake 'ACTIONED' answered-rate-ledger rows (~9% numerator inflation), and a dormant third acknowledged_at writer (signal-router.cjs's ackAndRouteLoneSignal, 0 rows ever produced) is the most likely place FR-4 gets wired and must not become a second silent-close path.

functional_requirements.title: Extend coordinator-ack-signal.cjs + receipt-ledger.cjs with a real disposition vocabulary and single canonical writer
functional_requirements.description: Widen receipt-ledger.cjs's existing 3-value DISPOSITIONS enum (ACTIONED/DECLINED/SUPERSEDED, lib/coordination/receipt-ledger.cjs:70-74) to the signal-lane's 5-value vocabulary (actioned/promoted/duplicate-of/rejected-with-reason/deferred-with-trigger) OR define an explicit mapping from the 5 signal-lane values onto the 3 existing ledger values -- buildReceipt() at receipt-ledger.cjs:89 currently silently drops any value not in its enum, so an unmapped 5th value would vanish from the ledger with no error. coordinator-ack-signal.cjs becomes the SOLE writer of a disposition onto a signal row (stamping both acknowledged_at, the existing retirement signal fleet-dashboard.cjs checks, and the new disposition value with writer identity) -- extend this file, do not create a second parallel writer. Mirror coordinator-ack-adam.cjs's mandatory-linkage pattern: 'rejected-with-reason' requires a non-empty reason string or the write is rejected before touching the DB (same shape as coordinator-ack-adam.cjs:226-248's LINKAGE_REQUIRED_DISPOSITIONS check); 'deferred-with-trigger' requires an explicit trigger condition or is rejected (mirrors coordinator-ack-adam.cjs:285-287). CORRECTION (TESTING, fd168314): receipt-ledger.cjs:89's buildReceipt() returns null for the WHOLE receipt object when a disposition is unmapped, not a single dropped field -- so an unmapped value stamps acknowledged_at while ZERO ledger rows are written, removing the signal from both the answered-rate numerator AND denominator. TS-3 must assert the receipt is non-null before any field-level check (a null-check-then-throw ordering bug would otherwise mask this as a TypeError, not a failed assertion).
acceptance_criteria: Calling the extended writer with disposition='actioned' on a fixture signal row sets BOTH acknowledged_at (non-null) and a disposition value with writer identity recorded, verified by re-reading the row.
Calling the writer with disposition='deferred-with-trigger' and no trigger argument is rejected before any DB write occurs (verified: row's acknowledged_at remains NULL).

A vocabulary-reconciliation test proves all 5 signal-lane disposition values map to a receipt-ledger DISPOSITIONS entry with no silent drop -- inject each of the 5 values and assert buildReceipt() does not omit any of them from the resulting receipt.

functional_requirements.description: CORRECTED (TESTING, fd168314): lib/fleet/outstanding-signals.cjs already implements the acknowledged_at IS NULL filter, oldest-first ordering, age reporting, truncation-honesty, and a read-only guarantee, with a named threshold DEFAULT_ALERT_AGE_MIN=30 and 20+ passing tests -- the original FR-2 (pointing at fleet-dashboard.cjs, inventing a new SIGNAL_DISPOSITION_SLA_MINUTES constant) would have duplicated this and reintroduced the exact vocabulary-drift class FR-1 exists to eliminate. EXEC must EXTEND outstanding-signals.cjs: widen its current single-session .eq('sender_session', sessionId) filter to a coordinator-wide view, and REUSE DEFAULT_ALERT_AGE_MIN as the SLA threshold (or rename it in place if a signal-lane-specific name is truly needed -- do not add a second, parallel constant for the same concept).
acceptance_criteria: A fixture signal row older than DEFAULT_ALERT_AGE_MIN appears in the widened (coordinator-wide, not single-session) surfaced oldest-first list with an explicit overdue marker.
A fixture signal row younger than DEFAULT_ALERT_AGE_MIN does NOT appear as overdue.
No new SLA constant is introduced; the existing DEFAULT_ALERT_AGE_MIN (or an explicit rename of it) is the single source of truth for this threshold.

functional_requirements.title: Live-queried backfill for the current open signal population, WITHOUT corrupting the answered-rate ledger
functional_requirements.description: MUST run AFTER FR-1 lands (ordering dependency -- the backfill needs FR-1's canonical writer/vocabulary to exist first). Query session_coordination live at run time (WHERE payload.signal_type IS NOT NULL AND acknowledged_at IS NULL), not a hardcoded row-id list or frozen count -- the 'as of 2026-08-24' figure of 262 open (109 never-touched + 153 already hand-stamped with a payload.disposition while acknowledged_at is still NULL) is a snapshot, and hand-stamping is confirmed still ongoing. CRITICAL CONSTRAINT (VALIDATION finding, sub_agent_execution_results eb009c8e-0ec1-49ec-bef7-b8cc2ff20d01): backfilled rows MUST NOT be written through FR-1's writer unmodified, because that writer hardcodes disposition:'ACTIONED' and isRetention:false unconditionally (coordinator-ack-signal.cjs:99,102) -- doing so would flatten the 153 rows' 10 distinct hand-stamped disposition texts into a single generic 'ACTIONED' value AND inject 262 rows indistinguishable from genuine coordinator answers into the answered-rate ledger (a ~9% numerator inflation on today's 2,864-row ledger, 610 of which are signal receipts). Backfilled rows MUST either (a) go through a distinct isRetention:true path that preserves the original hand-stamped disposition text verbatim, or (b) be excluded from the answered-rate ledger's receipt insert entirely. Pick one and document the choice; do not leave it ambiguous for EXEC to guess.
acceptance_criteria: Running the backfill against a fixture DB state (mix of never-touched and already-hand-stamped rows) leaves zero signal-lane rows with acknowledged_at NULL afterward.

The answered-rate ledger's row count and its is_retention=false (genuine-answer) subset are BYTE-IDENTICAL before and after a backfill run against a fixture population -- this is the primary regression test for the VALIDATION HIGH finding.

Each of the 153 already-hand-stamped rows' original disposition text is preserved (not flattened to a generic value) somewhere queryable after backfill -- verified by comparing pre/post text for a sample of the 10 distinct hand-stamped texts.
Re-running the backfill script a second time against an already-backfilled fixture is a no-op (idempotent) -- no duplicate ledger rows, no re-processing of already-closed rows.

functional_requirements.title: Widen SIGNAL_RESOLVED to cover lone (non-promoted) dispositioned signals, resolving the dormant third writer
functional_requirements.description: The existing SIGNAL_RESOLVED loop (scripts/stale-session-sweep.cjs's runCoordinatorHousekeeping, lines ~1945-2026) fires ONLY when payload.routed_to_sd_key is set, which scripts/sd-from-feedback.js:386-394 stamps ONLY on promotion (3+ same-fingerprint aggregation) -- it has NEVER fired in production (0 rows with routed_to_sd_key, 0 notification_sent, 0 SIGNAL_RESOLVED messages ever sent), so this is zero-yield, not merely narrow. CRITICAL CONSTRAINT (VALIDATION finding): a dormant third acknowledged_at writer already exists at lib/coordinator/signal-router.cjs:337-432 (shouldRouteLone/stampRoutedToCoordinator/ackAndRouteLoneSignal, from SD-FDBK-INFRA-CROSS-SESSION-CONFLICTION-001) -- self-documented as unreachable, 0 rows ever produced, stamps acknowledged_at with NO receipt-ledger call (the same 'invisible to measurement' defect FR-1 exists to fix), and has a fixture-blind bug where loadRecentSignals doesn't select acknowledged_at but branches on it (so in production the idempotency guard can never fire -- its tests pass only because every mock hand-supplies the field). EXEC must explicitly decide: either wire FR-1's canonical writer through this path (fixing the missing receipt-ledger call and the select-list gap) and widen SIGNAL_RESOLVED to trigger on FR-1's new disposition field directly (not routed_to_sd_key), or retire the dormant path entirely if superseded. Never leave both a fixed FR-1 path and an unfixed dormant path live simultaneously. Also add an explicit ORDER BY (created_at ASC) to the SIGNAL_RESOLVED candidate query, currently .limit(50) with no ordering -- invisible today at 0 candidates, a starvation risk once widened against 262 rows. CORRECTION (TESTING, fd168314): the fixture-blind bug is worse than initially scoped -- loadRecentSignals's missing acknowledged_at in its select list breaks TWO downstream branches in opposite directions: signal-router.cjs:414 degrades a guard (partially masked, since routed_to_coordinator lives inside the selected payload), but :379's idempotency check (`if (r.payload?.routed_to_coordinator && r.acknowledged_at) continue;`) is unconditionally false when acknowledged_at is undefined, making the `continue` UNREACHABLE in production -- an already-acked row gets RE-STAMPED with a fresh acknowledged_at on every tick, which also corrupts source_age_ms (computed at write time, unrecoverable later). Confirmed there is no recordReceipt() call at the :384-387 update either. ALSO: tests/helpers/postgrest-fixture-store.js's select() ignores its column-list argument and returns whole seeded rows -- seeding a 'real' row into this fixture is behaviourally IDENTICAL to the current hand-supplied mocks and cannot observe the projection bug. FR-4's tests for this specific defect need either (a) projection support added to the fixture, (b) a db-tier test against the real schema, or (c) a static source-pin test on the actual select() string (precedent: tests matching the ack-paths-explicit-id-source-pins.test.js pattern) -- a plain unit test with a mock client cannot catch this class of bug.
acceptance_criteria: POSITIVE CONTROL (resolves the VALIDATION finding that the existing negative-only test would be vacuous): disposing a lone, non-promoted fixture signal via FR-1's writer results in an actual SIGNAL_RESOLVED message reaching the sender's session -- not just the absence of a false trigger.

NEGATIVE CONTROL: promoting a fixture signal (3+ same-fingerprint) WITHOUT giving it an individual disposition does NOT fire SIGNAL_RESOLVED -- regression guard against reintroducing the prior defect where 9 critical signals silently vanished when stampRouted() disposed rows purely on promotion.

The dormant signal-router.cjs:337-432 path's fixture-blind bug is either fixed (loadRecentSignals selects acknowledged_at) with a test using a REAL row shape (not hand-supplied mock fields), or the path is retired -- one or the other, verified by which files exist/are called after EXEC.
The candidate query has an explicit ORDER BY; a test with >50 candidate rows confirms the oldest, not an arbitrary subset, is processed first.

sd_context.scope:
Signal-lane per-item disposition machinery, EXTENDING (not replacing) the existing thin ack mechanism.

## FR-1: Disposition writer extending coordinator-ack-signal.cjs + receipt-ledger.cjs
A signal-lane disposition vocabulary (actioned / promoted / duplicate-of / rejected-with-reason / deferred-with-trigger) stamped via a single canonical writer, mirroring coordinator-ack-adam.cjs's contract shape (ack retires the row via acknowledged_at; disposition is a separate, mandatory-linkage-checked stage; deferred requires a trigger). This is an EXTENSION of scripts/coordinator-ack-signal.cjs + lib/coordination/receipt-ledger.cjs, not a parallel mechanism -- a second, conflicting disposition writer would recreate the exact "drained visually, still open" defect this SD exists to close. Writer identity recorded (never a hand-stamp).

## FR-2: Coordinator inbox surfaces undispositioned signal age
Oldest-first undispositioned-signal age surfaced at the coordinator tick (fleet-dashboard.cjs's existing acknowledged_at IS NULL gate is the correct retirement signal to build on).

## FR-3: Backfill path for the current open signal population, DYNAMIC not a frozen count
The "162-row" figure named in the mint plan was a snapshot of one 2026-08-23T18:48:15Z remediation event and is already stale (262 open as of LEAD enrichment: 109 rows with acknowledged_at NULL and no payload.disposition at all, PLUS 153 rows carrying a hand-stamped payload.disposition while acknowledged_at is still NULL -- i.e. dispositioned-looking but structurally still open by the only mechanism the codebase actually checks). Manual hand-stamping is confirmed STILL ONGOING (5 more hand-stamps landed after the original batch, at 22:46:17Z and 01:41:25Z) -- the backfill must query live at run time, not target a hardcoded row count, and must canonicalize the 153 already-hand-stamped rows (retroactive writer-identity backfill) rather than only handling the 109 untouched ones.

## FR-4: SIGNAL_RESOLVED notify-back loop widened beyond the promotion-only path
The existing SIGNAL_RESOLVED loop (stale-session-sweep.cjs runCoordinatorHousekeeping) fires ONLY when payload.routed_to_sd_key is set, which is stamped ONLY when an aggregated/promoted feedback row (3+ same-fingerprint) becomes an SD (scripts/sd-from-feedback.js). A lone signal that receives an individual disposition (FR-1, never promoted) has NO path into this notify-back loop today. FR-4 must widen the trigger surface to also fire on a per-item terminal disposition, not just rename the field it keys off.

## Out of scope
Changing the aggregation/promotion threshold (lib/coordinator/signal-router.cjs's THRESHOLD=3/WINDOW_MIN=60); the /signal CLI's send side (scripts/worker-signal.cjs); stampRouted()'s deliberate non-disposing-on-promotion design (a prior fix for 9 critical signals silently vanishing -- do not reintroduce that regression by disposing a row purely because it was promoted).

## LEAD round-2 correction (VALIDATION sub_agent_execution_results eb009c8e-0ec1-49ec-bef7-b8cc2ff20d01, CONDITIONAL_PASS 88)
Independent re-verification confirmed all 7 mechanism_verifications citations accurate and the corrected 262-row live count exact, but surfaced 2 additional HIGH findings the LEAD-phase Explore pass missed (see risks): FR-3's naive backfill would corrupt the answered-rate ledger by ~9%, and a dormant third acknowledged_at writer (signal-router.cjs:337-432, 0 rows ever produced, no receipt-ledger call, fixture-blind idempotency bug) is the most likely place FR-4 gets wired and must not be left as a second silent-close path. PLAN's PRD MUST resolve both before EXEC -- also address: vocabulary reconciliation (this SD's proposed 5-value set vs the existing 3-value ACTIONED/DECLINED/SUPERSEDED enum, noting buildReceipt:89 silently drops unlisted values), an explicit FR-1-before-FR-3 ordering dependency, a concrete success criterion for FR-3, and a bound numeric SLA value for success_criteria[0] (currently unbound prose).
